blocks.text: ESTATE CLEANOUT FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions About Estate Cleanout in Aurora

items.q: How much does an estate cleanout cost in Aurora?
a: Pricing is based on how many rooms are affected — never the building type or its move-out policies. The figure is confirmed free at a private walkthrough.

items.q: Can the cleanout happen while a family member continues living in the home?
a: Yes. Work can proceed room by room while the resident stays in place, at whatever pace fits the family’s situation.

items.q: What happens if we find valuables, documents or sentimental items?
a: They’re set aside immediately and brought to the family, never sorted into a donation or disposal pile by default.

items.q: How careful are you around older homes near Aurora Village?
a: Genuinely careful. Original features that stay get protected, and the work moves at a pace that respects the property’s age and the family’s own timeline.

items.q: Can you coordinate directly with an executor or accountant?
